When two blades meet, or a character blocks an attack, the game goes through the outcomes below in order. The first outcome that applies happens. First, the defender may knock the attack away. Second, the attacker may break the defender's parry. Third, the attacker may bounce off a strong parry. Fourth, if both characters are attacking, the one with more power breaks the other's attack or makes it bounce. If none of these happens, the defender parries. A strong enough attacker then crushes the parry, and a weaker one is turned aside.
